_help: Control panel of the shop benchmark. Keys starting with '_' are comments. See the Readme, section Benchmarking.

target._help: Where the shop answers: start one framework with make run_<framework> first.

load._help: Every endpoint runs every profile, after a warm-up. A profile without rate_per_second pushes as many requests as its connections allow (throughput); with it, oha sends exactly that rate and corrects latency for requests that had to wait.

workload._help: What each request carries. The shop seeds 500 products (SKU-00001 to SKU-00500); order_lines is at most 20.

probe._help: Samples the CPU and memory of the server process listening on the target port (local targets only).

_endpoints_help: Empty runs all: get_json, post_json, get_stream, post_stream, get_binary, post_binary, get_text, post_text.
